packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: weekly with a 7 day cooldown, like Dependabot did
Leave action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
Dockerfile ARGs pin image components, so title their PRs "Update <name> to <version>"
Updates to an app image need a version bump and a changelog entry, which Renovate can't write
prBodyNotes: To release this update, bump `version` in the app's `config.yaml` and add a matching entry to its `CHANGELOG.md`.
